name: Zhu Hanping
current_role: Chairman and controlling shareholder, Hubei Sanfeng Intelligent Conveying Equipment (Sanfeng Intelligent, SZ:300276)
profile: Zhu Hanping founded Sanfeng Intelligent in 1999, a maker of intelligent conveying/automation equipment that listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext board in 2011. He is the company's legal representative, chairman and holds roughly 40% of its shares.
interesting_fact: A 2019 Shanghai Securities News profile described him as having stuck with manufacturing for 20 years, saying that after earning some money working for others he wanted to build a Chinese industrial company.
notes: Alive status not explicitly confirmed; sources indicate he still controls the company as of 2026 data. Shares wealth with Zhu Zhe. Best route likely via company board secretary/IR of Sanfeng Intelligent (300276).

name: Paul J Fribourg
current_role: Executive Chairman, Continental Grain Company (Conti); director of Loews, Estee Lauder and IFF
profile: Paul Fribourg is the sixth generation of his family to lead Continental Grain, the agribusiness and investment firm founded in Arlon, Belgium in 1813. He joined in 1976, ran European operations 1980-85, became chairman and CEO in 1997, and has recently transitioned to executive chairman.
interesting_fact: On stepping back as CEO he said: 'After 50 years and at age 72, it's time to turn things over to the next generation of leadership.'
deep_cut_fact: Before running the company he served as General Manager of Continental Grain's European operations from 1980 to 1985, after starting in merchandising roles in the US in 1976.
notes: Amherst College graduate; Council on Foreign Relations member. Wikipedia's 'CEO since 1976' is likely wrong (joined 1976, CEO from 1997).

name: Kwok Siu Ming
current_role: Chairman and CEO, Sa Sa International Holdings (HKEX:178)
profile: Dr Simon Kwok Siu Ming co-founded Sa Sa with his wife Eleanor Kwok in 1978, starting from a 40 sq ft cosmetics counter in Causeway Bay. He built it into a major Asian beauty retail chain, listed in Hong Kong in 1997, and remains chairman and CEO per the 2025/26 annual report.
interesting_fact: He was named Business Person of the Year at the DHL/SCMP Hong Kong Business Awards 2018.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Sa Sa he worked as a parking meter repairman; the first shop was a basement unit in President Shopping Centre on Jaffe Road, Causeway Bay.
notes: Also known as a racehorse owner (Royal Ascot owner profile exists). Wife Eleanor Kwok is vice-chairman.

name: Zheng Yaonan
current_role: Chairman and CEO, Cosmo Lady (China) Holdings (都市丽人, HKEX:2298)
profile: Zheng Yaonan founded underwear brand Cosmo Lady in 1998, targeting young urban women, and took it public in Hong Kong in 2014. He stepped back as CEO in 2019, then returned as CEO in November 2021 to lead a 'second entrepreneurship' turnaround; the group returned to profit in 2022.
interesting_fact: He expanded aggressively during the 2003 SARS outbreak; Cosmo Lady grew from about 50 stores to 6,272 stores by 2014.
deep_cut_fact: He holds a Shanghai Jiao Tong University EMBA and serves as executive vice president of the Guangdong Fujian Chamber of Commerce; he received Fujian's Outstanding Young Entrepreneur award.
notes: Media claim he rose 'from security guard to entrepreneur' is unverified; not used. Contact via Cosmo Lady (HKEX:2298) investor relations.

name: Dean Hoyle
current_role: Co-founder of Card Factory; former chairman and owner of Huddersfield Town AFC (sold June 2023)
profile: Dean Hoyle, born 1967 in Heckmondwike, West Yorkshire, co-founded greetings card chain Card Factory with his wife Janet in 1997 and grew it to 500+ shops before selling to Charterhouse in 2010 (reportedly for over £350m). He later chaired discount retailer The Works and owned Huddersfield Town, which he sold to Kevin Nagle's Town FC LLC in 2023.
interesting_fact: As Huddersfield Town chairman he won Championship CEO of the Year at the 2016 Football Business Awards; he is a lifelong Town supporter who joined the board in 2008.
deep_cut_fact: He went to White Lee Secondary School in Heckmondwike and studied engineering at Dewsbury and Batley Technical and Art College before going into retail.
notes: Huddersfield sale completed 22 June 2023 (https://www.walkermorris.co.uk/news/26805/). No published personal contact found; shares wealth with Janet Hoyle.

name: Pradeep Kumar Jain
current_role: Chairman & Managing Director, PNC Infratech Ltd (NSE: PNCINFRA)
profile: Pradeep Kumar Jain is the promoter, chairman and managing director of Agra-headquartered PNC Infratech, an Indian highway and infrastructure EPC/construction company. He ran PNC Construction Company as a sole proprietorship in Agra before it was folded into PNC Infratech (incorporated 1999), and oversees project administration, monitoring and government liaison.
interesting_fact: PNC Infratech grew out of his Agra sole proprietorship, PNC Construction Company, which the company acquired in exchange for equity shares; he has over 43 years in infrastructure.
deep_cut_fact: He holds a Bachelor of Arts degree, not an engineering degree, despite leading a major highway construction firm; he is also a director of PNC Cold Storage Pvt Ltd.
notes: IR handled by outside advisor Strategic Growth Advisors (per Q1 FY27 earnings call transcript). PNC Cold Storage directorship per MarketScreener. Emails cited from BSE filing letterheads as summarized by search; verify exact filing.

name: Dai Walters
current_role: Founder, Walters Group (civil engineering, plant hire and development, Hirwaun, Aberdare); racehorse owner

He also built and ran Ffos Las racecourse in Carmarthenshire (2009-2018) before selling it to Arena Racing Company.

name: Ernest S Rady
current_role: Executive Chairman, American Assets Trust, Inc. (NYSE: AAT)
profile: Winnipeg-born Ernest Rady (b. 1937) founded San Diego real estate firm American Assets, Inc. in 1967, which went public as American Assets Trust in 2011, and founded Insurance Company of the West and Westcorp in 1971. With his wife Evelyn he is a major San Diego philanthropist.
interesting_fact: Rady Children's Hospital and UC San Diego's Rady School of Management bear his name; he and Evelyn pledged $200 million to Rady Children's in 2018 and gave a $30 million lead gift to found the Rady School in 2004.
deep_cut_fact: American Assets began in 1967 with a single apartment complex in San Diego County bought for $35,000, which he initially ran out of the trunk of his car; earlier he worked in a fish factory and won the University of Manitoba Gold Medal in Commerce.
